base_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished portrait Human Resources game UI screen, exactly 850x1850, full bleed without phone hardware, presentation margins or multiple screens. Image 1 is the owner-approved HERO STYLE / FARM WORLD reference, not the screen layout to copy. Image 2 is the SHARED COMPONENT SYSTEM: reuse its exact panels, edging, shapes, button construction, type hierarchy, pictogram language, progress bars and palette. This is screen production inside that SAME kit, not a new visual theme.
Art direction locked: navy #08243D, cobalt #165BC1, cream #FFF1D0, coral #FF624C, mint #58EDC7, yellow #FFD45F. Retro space-age enamel signs with thin cream/coral trim, sparse consistent rivets, subtle upper-left light and down-right extrusion. A compact tilted title plaque like the component sheet; tall angular cream italic title with a slim coral offset. Text/rows stay horizontal below the title. Body is upright bold condensed sans and large enough for a phone. Maintain 40px side margins, 52px top safe space, 64px bottom safe space, ample internal padding and clear aligned rows. Decoration cannot touch text.
Use the hero's recognisable low-poly sage farmland, red barn, trees and blue saucer as world context; dim/desaturate it behind menu panels so reading is easy. No beige toy housing, CRT scanlines, parchment, glass dashboard, photoreal scene or generic app gradients. No giant repeated HUMAN RESOURCES logo: use this screen's short functional title. At most one small yellow star by title, no confetti.
Primary action: cobalt oval flying-saucer button with mint illuminated underside and cream title lettering, matching the hero START RUN/button specimen. Secondary/back: shared cream enamel rounded trapezoid with navy upright label/pictogram and coral edge. Cards: navy header/icon zone + cream body, mint fill for progress, selected mint rim plus check, three rank pips. Disabled controls are visibly muted with labels. Buttons and copy must fit cleanly, no tiny footnotes or overlapping elements.
Screen data is illustrative. Do not invent new mechanics, currencies, shop, daily rewards, online accounts, adverts or purchase offers. No web-style sidebar or bottom app navigation. Only render the controls and content explicitly specified below. Crisp accurate English labels, professional legibility, all text finished.

component_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE professional game UI COMPONENT REFERENCE SHEET, landscape composition about 1536x1024, derived precisely from the supplied hero home screen. This is the definitive reusable visual kit for twelve upcoming Human Resources screens, not another home-screen design.
Input image 1: exact art-direction reference. Reuse its retro dynamic cobalt/navy enamel signs, cream faces, coral offset edges, mint saucer lighting, occasional yellow starburst, simple pictograms and crisp tall punchy lettering. Keep its material, trim and lighting language. Avoid toy-console beige plastic, skeuomorphic CRT, paper dossiers and generic app cards.
Background: calm solid deep navy studio board with very subtle enamel texture, no farmland behind the component specimens.
Header: small "HUMAN RESOURCES" and "UI COMPONENT SYSTEM". Build an orderly 3-column grid of large isolated specimens with short readable labels, ample negative space.
Include: (1) compact tilted "ON HOLD" section-title sign, coral/cream rim, one tiny UFO and gold star; (2) primary oval flying-saucer button "RESUME", cobalt face, cream tall italic type, mint illuminated underside; (3) secondary cream-faced buttons "BACK" and "SETTINGS" with navy label/icons, coral trim; (4) navy/cream hardware card "LASER ARRAY" / "RANK II" / "2 > 3 LASERS", 3 rank pips, mint selected outline + check; (5) same card in muted locked state with lock icon and "LOCKED"; (6) slim "SHIELD 30 / 60" mint progress bar with navy trough, cream keyline; (7) segmented tabs "HARDWARE", "RESEARCH", "HANGAR" selected Hardware; (8) matching toggle specimens "SOUND ON" and "MOTION OFF", mint check vs empty dark; (9) compact credit pill "1,240 CR"; (10) small protection dialog "PROGRESS PROTECTED" with a "RETRY SAVE" button and explanatory text area.
Show palette swatches labelled NAVY / COBALT / CREAM / CORAL / MINT / GOLD, colour values #08243D #165BC1 #FFF1D0 #FF624C #58EDC7 #FFD45F. A small typography specimen: slanted display "PROMOTION"; upright readable body "Choose one upgrade. Your flight is paused."
All elements should look like a reusable production game UI family. Heading signs may tilt, but controls/body text stay ordered and highly legible. Surface edge weight, rivet size, corner roundness, drop-shadow direction, highlights, icon weight and palette are IDENTICAL throughout. No phone devices, no tiny unreadable annotations, no alternative themes.

screens.name: Gameplay / Flight HUD
screens.prompt:
The active flight screen. NO large menu panel or heading sign: world occupies 80%+ of the screen. Show the same low-poly farm and hero cobalt saucer capturing a cow; add a few readable humans/sheep and one small military jeep with coral projectile warning to establish gameplay.
At top within safe area, compact shared navy enamel HUD pods: left HP 85 / 120 with mint health bar and SHIELD 30 / 60 with light-mint bar; middle LV 7 and a gold XP bar; right SCORE 790 and separate large pause II control. Do not make each number a giant sign.
Lower-left a faint mint circular floating thumbstick, comfortably separated from information. Above it small navy status pod "SWEEP 2 / 3" with three pips (two filled) and a thin timer bar. Bottom-right one compact saucer action "DASH" and "READY". No other menu navigation. A tiny transient cream-edged feedback tag near the UFO says "LASER ARRAY II INSTALLED"; it must not cover targets. Ship and world remain the focus. Damage feedback and capture beam stay readable.

screens.name: Level-up / Promotion
screens.prompt:
Paused level-up choice screen, dim farm behind. Compact top tilted sign "PROMOTION" with small "LEVEL 8" badge. Upright subheading "Choose one. Your flight is paused." Hardware strip "4 / 6 HARDWARE" with four filled of six slot pips.
Three equally sized large stacked CHOOSABLE cards, each using shared navy header, cream body, consistent pictogram tile, rank pips and a small "CHOOSE" corner cue:
1. "LASER ARRAY", "COMMON · RANK II", headline "LASERS 2 > 3", body "Adds one laser at 50% original damage." Two of three pips.
2. "TRACTOR LENS", "COMMON · RANK II", headline "PICKUP REACH 4.4 > 4.8m", body "Active beams stay locked outside the ring." Two of three pips.
3. "WEAPON DAMAGE", "FLIGHT RESEARCH", headline "ORIGINAL LASER DAMAGE +5%", body "Temporary bonus for this flight."
Keep exact change info prominent and descriptions readable. No selected card check before a choice is made; equal visual weight, no fake recommendation or selected state. Bottom paired secondary buttons "REROLL · 2 LEFT" and "EVOLUTIONS". No separate Continue action and no Back that would skip the earned choice.
